gaps.snippet: impl < E : 'static > Lazy < E > { # [doc = " Construct a `Lazy<E>` from an initial state `s` and a step function `f`."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " `f(state)` returns `Some((element, next_state))` to yield an element and advance the"] # [doc = " state, or `None` to signal exhaustion."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " # Guarantee tag: `Declared` — not total"] # [doc = " The resulting `Lazy` may produce infinitely many elements if `f` never returns `None`."] # [doc = " The `Declared` tag is the honest floor (spec §4; VR-5)."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " # EXPLAIN: the lazy/declared artifact"] # [doc = " Every `Lazy<E>` value carries an implicit \"lazy / may-not-terminate\" `Declared`"] # [doc = " artifact visible in the type: it is a `Lazy<E>`, not a `Foldable<E>`. The type name"] # [doc = " itself is the EXPLAIN record (C3 / spec §5 C3)."] pub fn unfold < S : 'static > (init : S , mut f : impl FnMut (S) -> Option < (E , S) > + 'static) -> Self { let mut state = Some (init) ; Lazy { step : Box :: new (move | | { let s = state . take () ? ; match f (s) { Some ((elem , next_s)) => { state = Some (next_s) ; Some (elem) } None => None , } }) , } } # [doc = " Consume `self`, driving the source for up to `n` elements."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " This is called by [`lazy_take`](crate::lazy_take) and is the **only** sanctioned way to"] # [doc = " re-establish totality over a `Lazy` source (the `Nat` bound makes it terminating)."] # [doc = ""] # [doc = " # Guarantee tag: `Exact` — total given the bound (spec §4 `lazy_take` row)"] # [must_use] pub fn take (mut self , n : usize) -> Foldable < E > { let mut result = Vec :: with_capacity (n) ; for _ in 0 .. n { match (self . step) () { Some (e) => result . push (e) , None => break , } } Foldable :: from_vec (result) } }
